endpoint: 6 h target-gene RNA; repeat inventory for each separate assay/endpoint
excludes: independent pilot of at least four complete days
primary_estimand: Three primary estimands with Holm correction: A_M, A_T and C = A_M - A_T, where A_s = (3A - WT in EGFP fusion) - (3A - WT in untagged) at stimulus s; equivalently C = (Delta_E_M - Delta_U_M) - (Delta_E_T - Delta_U_T)
minimum_precision_target: 95% CI half-width 0.5 log2 units for C (the most variable estimand), sample size fixed from separate pilot; not an equivalence margin
scope: Linker-EGFP fusion architecture, not EGFP alone; mature RNA abundance unless nascent RNA validated

R06.status: conditional on an R02 architecture effect
R06.contrasts: A^{E-L} and A^{L-U} at each drug; one Holm family of four
